_comment: The Parameters tab: nDXplorer's constants (Qt: ui/parameter_editor.py). A vector constant is an expandable row with one child per population. An edit re-derives the columns that read the constant.

columns.title: Name
columns.tooltip: A vector (▸ gamma [2]) holds one value per population; open it for the elements.

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Fixed: a fit that reads this constant leaves it alone.

columns.title: Lo
columns.tooltip: Lower bound. −∞: none. Type a number to set it, nothing (or ∞) to remove it.

columns.title: Hi
columns.tooltip: Upper bound. ∞: none. Type a number to set it, nothing (or ∞) to remove it.

columns.title: Link
columns.tooltip: The fit parameter this constant follows (right-click to link or unlink). Shown while a constant is linked.

sections.text: Right-click a row to copy, paste, link, or make it a vector (one value per population).
